highlights: 30W Retractable USB-C Cable: This UGREEN car charger features a built-in retractable USB-C charging cable that supports 30W fast charging for phones and tablets. The cable can extend up to 70cm and lock securely at any point according to your needs, delivering precise length control for tangle-free charging

60W Fast Charging: This retractable car charger offers a maximum output of 60W when the built-in cable and the USB-C or USB-A port are used simultaneously. When used alone, every port can support 30W.

3-in-1 Car Charger: This cigarette lighter USB charger allows you to fast charge 3 devices simultaneously, supports multiple charging protocols like PD 3.0, QC 3.0, PPS, SCP, AFC, etc. This car charger can intelligently adjust power output to match connected devices, which can better protect your device's battery

Compact and Neat Design: This car phone charger is incredibly compact and portable. The built-in retractable cable keeps your car interior neat and uncluttered, which is better for maintaining an organized driving environment

Wide Compatibility: The car charger adapter works with almost all 12-24V vehicles and is compatible with phone series like iPhone 17/16/15, Galaxy S25/24, and other devices like iPad, iPods, Dash Cameras, etc
